q20115.en: The sign shown is an advance warning of the obligation to turn right.

explain.short: The curved arrow warns you early: at the next junction you will have to turn right.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'preavviso' means advance warning: the turn comes later, at the junction ahead.

sceneParams.caption: Warning: you must turn right at the next junction

q20116.en: The sign shown announces that going straight on or turning left is not allowed.

explain.short: If you must turn right, then straight on and left are both forbidden at that junction.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' means it is not allowed: only right is left as a choice.

sceneParams.caption: Only right: no straight on, no left

q20117.en: The sign shown comes before a junction where you must turn right.

explain.short: It is placed before the junction, to warn you that there you must turn right.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'precede' means it comes before: the sign is not at the junction itself.

sceneParams.caption: Placed before a junction: turn right there

q20118.en: The sign shown announces a junction where going straight on is not allowed.

explain.short: At that junction you must turn right, so going straight on is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito proseguire diritto' means you may not go straight on.

sceneParams.caption: Straight on is forbidden: turn right

q20119.en: The sign shown announces that turning left is not allowed.

explain.short: You must turn right at the next junction, so turning left is forbidden there.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'girare a sinistra' means turning left: it is excluded because only right is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Left is forbidden: only right

q20120.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: Mandatory signs (blue discs) are prescription signs, like prohibition signs.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (regulatory signs) is the big family: it contains both prohibition and mandatory signs.

sceneParams.caption: Mandatory sign = prescription sign

q20121.en: The sign shown announces the only direction allowed.

explain.short: At the next junction right is the only direction you may take.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'l'unica direzione' means the only direction: here it is right.

sceneParams.caption: Right is the only direction allowed

q20122.en: The sign shown is a mandatory sign.

explain.short: Blue round signs with white arrows are mandatory signs: they tell you what you must do.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' means obligation: blue disc = you must; red ring = you must not.

sceneParams.caption: Blue disc = mandatory sign

q20123.en: The sign shown can be completed with a panel showing the distance to the point where the obligation applies.

explain.short: Because it is a warning placed before the junction, a panel can say how far away the junction is.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'può essere integrato' means it can be completed: an extra panel, for example '150 m'.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can show the distance to the junction

q20124.en: The sign shown indicates that turning right is not allowed at the next junction.

explain.short: It is the opposite: at the next junction you MUST turn right.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito svoltare a destra' would be a prohibition: a red ring, not a blue disc.

sceneParams.caption: Not forbidden: right is COMPULSORY

q20125.en: The sign shown obliges you to go straight on or turn right.

explain.short: There is only one curved arrow: right is the only choice, straight on is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'diritto o svoltare a destra' needs two arrows (up and right); this sign has only one.

sceneParams.caption: One arrow: only right, not straight on

q20126.en: The sign shown imposes the obligation to pass on the right of an obstacle.

explain.short: Passing an obstacle on the right has a different sign: an arrow pointing down to the right.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'ostacolo' (obstacle) is a trap: this curved arrow is about a turn at a junction.

sceneParams.caption: A right turn at a junction, not an obstacle

q20127.en: The sign shown indicates a dangerous bend to the right.

explain.short: A dangerous bend is a red triangle (danger sign); this blue disc is a mandatory sign.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'curva pericolosa' is a danger warning: triangle, not blue disc.

sceneParams.caption: Not a bend: compulsory right turn

q20128.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a merging road from the right.

explain.short: A merging road (confluenza) is shown by a red triangle; this blue disc obliges you to turn right.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'confluenza' (another road joining yours) is a danger sign, not a blue disc.

sceneParams.caption: Not a merge: you must turn right

q20129.en: The sign shown obliges lorries and slow vehicles to queue in the right lane.

explain.short: The sign is for every driver and is about a turn at the junction, not about lanes.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'autocarri ed i veicoli lenti' (lorries and slow vehicles): the sign names no vehicle type.

sceneParams.caption: For everyone: turn right, no lane rule

q20130.en: The sign shown is a prohibition sign.

explain.short: Prohibition signs have a red ring; this blue disc with a white arrow is a mandatory sign.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'divieto' means prohibition: red ring. Blue disc means 'obbligo'.

sceneParams.caption: Blue disc: mandatory, not prohibition

q20131.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: It does not just inform: it obliges you to turn right, so it is a mandatory sign.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information signs) are usually rectangles; this is a round blue mandatory sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not information: an obligation

q20132.en: The sign shown is a danger warning sign.

explain.short: Danger signs are red triangles; this blue disc tells you which way you must go.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'preavviso di pericolo' means danger warning: a triangle, not a blue disc.

sceneParams.caption: Not danger: compulsory direction

q20133.en: The sign shown announces a deceleration lane.

explain.short: It does not talk about lanes: it obliges you to turn right at the next junction.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'corsia di decelerazione' (slowing-down lane to leave a road) has its own signs.

sceneParams.caption: Not a lane: turn right at the junction

q20134.en: The sign shown comes before the COMPULSORY DIRECTION RIGHT sign.

explain.short: First comes this advance warning; at the junction itself there is the compulsory direction sign.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'precede' means comes before: this is the warning, the real sign is at the junction.

sceneParams.caption: Warning first, then the sign at the junction

q20135.en: The sign shown announces that going straight on is not allowed.

explain.short: At the next junction you must turn right, so straight on is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'proseguire diritto' means go straight on: not allowed here.

sceneParams.caption: Straight on is forbidden: turn right

q20136.en: The sign shown announces that turning left is not allowed.

explain.short: At the next junction you must turn right, so turning left is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'svoltare a sinistra' means turn left: excluded, only right is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Left is forbidden: only right

q20137.en: The sign shown is placed before a junction.

explain.short: It is an advance warning, so it stands some distance before the junction.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'prima di un incrocio' means before a junction: that is where an advance warning goes.

sceneParams.caption: Placed before the junction

q20138.en: The sign shown is a mandatory sign.

explain.short: Blue disc with a white arrow = mandatory sign: it tells you what you must do.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' means obligation: blue disc. A red ring would be 'divieto'.

sceneParams.caption: Blue disc = mandatory sign

q20139.en: The sign shown announces a one-way street.

explain.short: One-way is a rectangular information sign; this blue disc obliges you to turn right.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way street) has a white arrow on a rectangle, not a round disc.

sceneParams.caption: Not one-way: compulsory right turn

q20140.en: The sign shown obliges you to turn right immediately.

explain.short: It is an advance warning: you turn right at the next junction, not straight away.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'subito' means immediately: wrong, the obligation is at the junction ahead.

sceneParams.caption: Not immediately: at the next junction

q20141.en: The sign shown does not allow the right turn.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the right turn is compulsory, the only direction allowed.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'non consente' (does not allow) turns the meaning upside down: right is a must.

sceneParams.caption: Right is not forbidden: it is compulsory

q20142.en: The sign shown indicates that you must pass on the right of the obstacle.

explain.short: Passing an obstacle on the right uses an arrow pointing down to the right; this curved arrow means turn right.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'ostacolo' (obstacle) is the trap: this sign is about a junction.

sceneParams.caption: A turn at a junction, not an obstacle

q20143.en: The sign shown announces the obligation to turn left.

explain.short: The arrow bends to the right: the obligation is to turn right, not left.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved right arrow. At the next junction you must turn right; straight on and left are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'sinistra' means left: look at the arrow, it points right.

sceneParams.caption: The arrow points RIGHT, not left

q20144.en: The sign shown is an advance warning of the obligation to turn left.

explain.short: The curved arrow to the left warns you early: at the next junction you must turn left.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'preavviso' means advance warning: the turn comes later, at the junction.

sceneParams.caption: Warning: you must turn left at the next junction

q20145.en: The sign shown comes before a junction where going straight on or turning right is not allowed.

explain.short: At that junction you must turn left, so straight on and right are both forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' means not allowed: only left remains.

sceneParams.caption: Only left: no straight on, no right

q20146.en: The sign shown announces the obligation to turn left at the next junction.

explain.short: It is placed before the junction and tells you that there you must turn left.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'al prossimo incrocio' means at the next junction: not immediately.

sceneParams.caption: Turn left at the next junction

q20147.en: The sign shown comes before a junction where it is compulsory to turn left.

explain.short: It stands before the junction; at the junction itself you must turn left.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'precede' means comes before: the sign is not on the junction.

sceneParams.caption: Placed before a junction: turn left there

q20148.en: The sign shown is an advance warning of compulsory direction sign.

explain.short: That is its official name: 'preavviso di direzione obbligatoria'.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'preavviso' + 'direzione obbligatoria': warning before, then a direction you must take.

sceneParams.caption: Official name: advance warning of compulsory direction

q20149.en: The sign shown announces the only direction allowed.

explain.short: At the next junction left is the only direction you may take.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'l'unica direzione' means the only direction: here it is left.

sceneParams.caption: Left is the only direction allowed

q20150.en: The sign shown can be completed with a panel showing the distance to the point where the obligation applies.

explain.short: Because it is placed before the junction, a panel can say how far away the junction is.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'può essere integrato' means it can be completed with an extra panel, for example '200 m'.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can show the distance to the junction

q20151.en: The sign shown indicates that turning left is not allowed at the next junction.

explain.short: It is the opposite: at the next junction you MUST turn left.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' would make it a prohibition (red ring); a blue disc is an obligation.

sceneParams.caption: Not forbidden: left is COMPULSORY

q20152.en: The sign shown obliges you to go straight on or turn left.

explain.short: There is only one curved arrow: left is the only choice, straight on is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'diritto o a svoltare a sinistra' would need two arrows; this sign has one.

sceneParams.caption: One arrow: only left, not straight on

q20153.en: The sign shown announces that you go straight on but do not turn right.

explain.short: Straight on is forbidden too: the only allowed direction is left.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'andare diritto' is wrong: the arrow bends left, it does not go straight.

sceneParams.caption: Not straight on: only left

q20154.en: The sign shown gives advance warning that the road you turn left into is one-way.

explain.short: It does not say anything about one-way traffic: it only obliges you to turn left.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) is a different, rectangular sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not one-way: compulsory left turn

q20155.en: The sign shown is a prohibition sign.

explain.short: Prohibition signs have a red ring; this blue disc is a mandatory sign.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'divieto' = red ring. Blue disc = 'obbligo'.

sceneParams.caption: Blue disc: mandatory, not prohibition

q20156.en: The sign shown announces an acceleration lane.

explain.short: It is not about lanes: it obliges you to turn left at the next junction.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'corsia di accelerazione' (lane to speed up and join a road) has its own signs.

sceneParams.caption: Not a lane: turn left at the junction

q20157.en: The sign shown announces a recommended direction.

explain.short: A blue disc is not advice: the left turn is compulsory.
explain.rule: 'Preavviso di direzione obbligatoria' (advance warning of compulsory direction): a blue disc with a curved left arrow. At the next junction you must turn left; straight on and right are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'consigliata' means recommended: wrong, 'obbligatoria' means you must.

sceneParams.caption: Not advice: the direction is COMPULSORY

q20158.en: The sign shown indicates the allowed directions right and left.

explain.short: The two arrows show the two directions you may take: right or left.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'consentite' means allowed: both arrows are allowed choices.

sceneParams.caption: Right or left allowed, not straight on

q20159.en: The sign shown obliges you to turn right or left at the next junction.

explain.short: You must choose one of the two arrows: right or left. Straight on is not an option.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'obbliga' means obliges: you have to turn, one way or the other.

sceneParams.caption: You must turn: right or left

q20160.en: The sign shown indicates that going straight on at the junction is not allowed.

explain.short: There is no arrow pointing up, so straight on is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito proseguire diritto' means no straight on: the up arrow is missing.

sceneParams.caption: No arrow up: straight on forbidden

q20161.en: The sign shown is a mandatory sign.

explain.short: Blue disc with white arrows = mandatory sign: you must take one of the shown directions.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' = blue disc; a red ring would be a prohibition.

sceneParams.caption: Blue disc = mandatory sign

q20162.en: The sign shown indicates that it is impossible to go straight on.

explain.short: There is no straight arrow: you may only turn right or left.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'impossibilità' means it is not possible (not allowed) to go straight on.

sceneParams.caption: Straight on is not possible

q20163.en: The sign shown indicates the only directions allowed.

explain.short: Right and left are the only two directions you may take.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'le uniche direzioni' means the only directions: the two arrows, nothing else.

sceneParams.caption: Only these two directions

q20164.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: Mandatory signs are prescription signs, like prohibition signs.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (regulatory signs) includes both 'divieto' and 'obbligo'.

sceneParams.caption: Mandatory sign = prescription sign

q20165.en: The sign shown indicates that you must form two queues to go straight on.

explain.short: You may not go straight on at all: you must turn right or left.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'per proseguire diritto' is the trap: straight on is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: No straight on: turn right or left

q20166.en: The sign shown indicates that overtaking is allowed both on the right and on the left.

explain.short: The arrows show directions at a junction, not overtaking.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'sorpasso' (overtaking) is not on this sign: it is about turning right or left.

sceneParams.caption: Directions at a junction, not overtaking

keywords.it: sia a destra che a sinistra

q20167.en: The sign shown indicates the start of two-way traffic.

explain.short: Two-way traffic is a red triangle (danger sign); this blue disc obliges you to turn.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'doppio senso di circolazione' (two-way traffic) is a danger sign, not a blue disc.

sceneParams.caption: Not two-way traffic: turn right or left

q20168.en: The sign shown indicates that you may pass on the right or on the left of a traffic island.

explain.short: Passing either side of an island has a sign with arrows pointing DOWN; these arrows turn at a junction.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'isola spartitraffico' (traffic island) is the trap: this sign is about a junction.

sceneParams.caption: Junction turns, not a traffic island

q20169.en: The sign shown indicates that passing is allowed on the right and on the left of an obstacle.

explain.short: 'Passaggi consentiti' around an obstacle is another sign with downward arrows; here the arrows mean turning.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'ostacolo' (obstacle) is the trap: there is no obstacle, only a junction.

sceneParams.caption: Junction turns, not an obstacle

q20170.en: The sign shown is a prohibition sign.

explain.short: Prohibition signs have a red ring; this blue disc is a mandatory sign.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'divieto' = red ring. Blue disc = 'obbligo'.

sceneParams.caption: Blue disc: mandatory, not prohibition

q20171.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: It does not just inform: it obliges you to turn right or left, so it is a mandatory sign.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information signs) are usually rectangles; this is a round blue sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not information: an obligation

q20172.en: The sign shown indicates the start of traffic in parallel lines.

explain.short: It does not talk about lanes or rows: it tells you to turn right or left at the junction.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'file parallele' (parallel rows of traffic) is not what the two arrows mean.

sceneParams.caption: Not parallel rows: turn right or left

q20173.en: The sign shown indicates that turning right is allowed.

explain.short: One of the two arrows points right: turning right is allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'consentito' means allowed: right is one of the two choices.

sceneParams.caption: Right is allowed (left too)

q20174.en: The sign shown indicates that turning left is allowed.

explain.short: One of the two arrows points left: turning left is allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'consentito' means allowed: left is one of the two choices.

sceneParams.caption: Left is allowed (right too)

q20175.en: The sign shown indicates that going straight on is not allowed.

explain.short: There is no arrow pointing up, so straight on is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito proseguire diritto': the straight arrow is missing.

sceneParams.caption: No arrow up: straight on forbidden

q20176.en: The sign shown indicates that you can choose between the two allowed directions.

explain.short: You decide: right or left, both are allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'si può scegliere' means you can choose: either arrow is fine.

sceneParams.caption: Your choice: right or left

q20177.en: The sign shown indicates that there is a dangerous fork in the road very close by.

explain.short: A blue disc does not warn of danger: it tells you which directions are allowed.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'biforcazione pericolosa' (dangerous fork) would be a danger sign, a red triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Not danger: allowed directions

q20178.en: The sign shown indicates that you must form two queues to go straight on.

explain.short: You may not go straight on at all: you must turn right or left.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'per proseguire diritto' is the trap: straight on is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: No straight on: turn right or left

q20179.en: The sign shown indicates that you may pass on both the right and the left of the solid line.

explain.short: The sign has nothing to do with road markings: it shows the directions at a junction.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'striscia continua' (solid line) is a road marking, not on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not about a solid line: turn right or left

q20180.en: The sign shown indicates two parallel one-way streets.

explain.short: One-way streets have rectangular signs; this blue disc shows the allowed turns.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite destra e sinistra' (allowed directions right and left): a blue disc with one arrow to the left and one to the right. At the junction you choose right or left; straight on is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'due sensi unici paralleli' (two parallel one-way streets) is not the meaning of the arrows.

sceneParams.caption: Not one-way streets: turn right or left

q20181.en: The sign shown obliges you to go straight on or turn right at the junction.

explain.short: The two arrows show the only choices: straight on or right.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'obbliga' means obliges: you must take one of these two directions.

sceneParams.caption: Straight on or right: you must pick one

q20182.en: The sign shown allows only going straight on or turning right.

explain.short: There are two arrows, up and right: these are the only allowed directions.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'solo' means only: straight on and right, nothing else.

sceneParams.caption: Only straight on or right

q20183.en: The sign shown does not allow the left turn at the junction.

explain.short: There is no left arrow, so turning left is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'non consente' means does not allow: left is missing from the sign.

sceneParams.caption: No left arrow: left is forbidden

q20184.en: The sign shown indicates that it is impossible to turn left.

explain.short: Only straight on and right are allowed, so you cannot turn left.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'impossibilità' means not possible (not allowed): left is excluded.

sceneParams.caption: Left is not possible

q20185.en: The sign shown indicates the only directions allowed.

explain.short: Straight on and right are the only two directions you may take.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'le uniche direzioni' means the only directions: the two arrows, nothing else.

sceneParams.caption: Only straight on and right

q20186.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: Mandatory signs are prescription signs, like prohibition signs.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (regulatory signs) includes both 'divieto' and 'obbligo'.

sceneParams.caption: Mandatory sign = prescription sign

q20187.en: The sign shown is a mandatory sign.

explain.short: Blue disc with white arrows = mandatory sign: you must take one of the shown directions.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' = blue disc; a red ring would be a prohibition.

sceneParams.caption: Blue disc = mandatory sign

q20188.en: The sign shown allows only going straight on.

explain.short: There are two arrows: you may go straight on OR turn right.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: right is allowed too.

sceneParams.caption: Not only straight: right is allowed too

q20189.en: The sign shown indicates that only turning right is allowed.

explain.short: There are two arrows: straight on is allowed too, not only right.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is the trap: straight on is also allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Not only right: straight on too

q20190.en: The sign shown obliges you to pass on the right of roadworks.

explain.short: It is about directions at a junction, not about passing roadworks.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'cantiere stradale' (roadworks) is not on this sign; passing an obstacle uses a downward arrow.

sceneParams.caption: Junction directions, not roadworks

q20191.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: It does not just inform: it obliges you to go straight on or right, so it is a mandatory sign.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information signs) are usually rectangles; this is a round blue sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not information: an obligation

q20192.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: Danger signs are red triangles; this blue disc tells you which directions you may take.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' (danger) = triangle; blue disc = 'obbligo'.

sceneParams.caption: Not danger: allowed directions

q20193.en: The sign shown indicates the upcoming start of an extra lane reserved for slow vehicles.

explain.short: It does not talk about lanes: it shows that you may go straight on or turn right.
explain.rule: 'Direzioni consentite diritto e destra' (allowed directions straight and right): a blue disc with an arrow up and an arrow to the right. At the junction you may only go straight on or turn right; left is forbidden.
explain.trap: 'corsia supplementare' (extra lane for slow vehicles) has its own rectangular sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not an extra lane: straight on or right
